name: Rivelte
source:
Attribute: Amethyst

A student attending school. Chatty enough you could call her "Rivelte Machine Gun Talk".

[spoiler]She lost her parents at a very young age and lives alone. In truth, she fears solitude more than anything else.

She hates being alone, so she always puts on a cheerful act.[/spoiler]

[Based off description from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/janis/magicalpalette/]Janis official website[/url]]
